notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Added:

 New network animation
Now the player can see the animation of the other player when he is holding a trap, a gun or binoculars

 Head and body rotation
Rotation of the body and head, when the player rotate own the camera, aiming and looking through binoculars

Fixed:

 Syncing animation
New animation synchronization algorithm

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Added:

     Traps
Added traps. Now players can find and place a trap on the ground. The location of the trap is displayed on the map
     Flashlight flares
Now when player rotate to other player, that player can see flares

Fixed:

 Teleportation in multiplayer
Fixed move others players on client. Now other players moved smoothly
 Players could not take equipment 
Fixed bug when players try to take a map, flashlight and binoculars
